# Characters (humans)

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/characters.yaml. Do not edit. -->

Every character type `CfgChar` configures. A level script creates a character (a *human*) with
`HuCreate(name, type, position, heading, ...)`, and the type picks everything below: the model, health,
damage and attack tables, voice, hat and weapon. See [Characters](../research/characters.md#classes).

Speeds are what the game uses in play: each clip's root displacement over its length, for the clip the
type's character data plays in the walk, jog, run and sprint slots (the generic clip when it has none of
its own). The [speed class](speed-classes.md) is only a fallback.

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every type `CfgChar` configures (449) is listed with every argument. The labels (who a type is)
    are hand-written and still sparse; the meaning of `flag_14b` is not traced.

449 entries. Data: `research/references/characters.yaml`.

## Sources and evidence

Evidence levels used: inferred.

- config_preload2.lua, CfgChar

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | int | | Character type: the number `HuCreate` takes and `CfgChar` configures. |
| `label` | str | yes | Our short name for the type (who it is). |
| `model` | str | | Model name: the Character List entry the type uses. |
| `armies_model` | str | | The `<model>_a` model used instead in levels 60-64, when the list has one. |
| `faction` | str | | The group the model's name prefix stands for (our reading of the prefix). |
| `behaviour` | int | | Byte `+0x11a`: the brain kind given to the human's AI (3 the Warriors, 4 civilians). |
| `category` | int | | Byte `+0x11b`: role category; picks the cash range and civilian reactions (14 Warriors). |
| `speed_class` | int | | Byte `+0x11c`: the [speed class](speed-classes.md) used when no clip speeds exist. |
| `v11d` | int | | Byte `+0x11d`: the [power class](power-classes.md) (human `+0x1b8`, and `+0x1b9` for a player unless a Warriors type gets its Warrior's). |
| `health` | int | | 16-bit `+0x116`, copied to the human's maximum and current health. |
| `damage_table` | str | | The 45-entry damage table (a global of `config_preload2.lua`). |
| `attack_table` | str | | The 45-entry attack table. |
| `damage_scale` | float | | Multiplier applied to the damage table. |
| `range_table` | str | | The 45-entry range table. |
| `hat` | str | | Hat object worn (an [object](objects.md) name), or none. |
| `voice` | int | | Voice set: the folder number of `vags/character/voices/<n>/...` (16-bit `+0x118`). |
| `flag_14b` | int | | Byte `+0x14b`, copied to the human (`+0x3b8`); changes the body scale and a civilian colour. |
| `drop_group` | str | | Item or object group the human may carry (`+0x16c`). |
| `drop_chance` | int | | Value at `+0xb4` used with the item: compared with a random 0-99 (a chance, inferred). |
| `weapon` | str | | Weapon object the human is given at creation (`+0x18c`), or none. |
| `speeds` | dict | | Walk, jog, run and sprint in m/s from the model's clips (root displacement / duration). |
| `script_names` | list | | Names level scripts give humans of this type (`HuCreate`'s first argument). |
| `levels` | list | | Level numbers whose scripts create this type with a constant type argument. |
| `image` | str | | A thumbnail, a path below `docs/references/images/` (`characters/warr_re_cv.png`); set by extract from the files present. |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
